description: Dear Neighbor,Eastern North Carolina has always been home for me, and it’s a privilege I don’t take lightly to serve the people of Lenoir, Greene, and Jones counties. Whether I’m in Raleigh or back home, my focus remains the same — listening to our communities and working hard to deliver results that make a real difference.This month’s update includes a mix of personal news, local wins, and advancements we’re making together across the district. I’m grateful for your continued trust and support,
